caption: The drawing displays a single round object resembling a shallow bowl or pan, centered within a rectangular frame. The bowl has a smooth gradation of shading from dark on the upper left and outer edge, fading to lighter tones toward the inner center, creating a sense of depth. At the top of the bowl, there is an ornamental, scalloped extension with a hole near its upper edge, and the letters "A M" are inscribed on it. Below the bowl, a rectangular box contains a detailed sketch of a handle or bracket with dimensions labeled in inches: "5 1/2" along the top, "2 1/2" for the curved portion, and "4" across the bottom. This box is positioned so that part of it overlaps the base of the main rectangle. The entire piece is executed in shades of gray on a tan background, with careful use of pencil for shading and precise line work for details and measurements. The name "Charles Cullen" appears signed in the lower right corner.
title: Pewter Porringer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
